Our visitors, as last year, again brought a strong team along containing several University athletes, and Tommy Hampson, the International runner, and a member of our Club.
HAMPSON, the Surrey half-mile champion, is a second-claim member, he seems to be one of us, just as H.

Hampson a little to strong for him in the last few yards. Our man's running gave the crowd a great thrill, for it gripped the imagination to see a young runner not yet 21 giving Hampson a keen tussle and making men like Gutteridge and Ellis look like "selling-platers."
Scrimshaw distinguished himself by running second in his heat (his time being 1min. 56 2-5sec.) and fourth in the Final, with T. Hampson, S.
The finalists were Hampson, Peltzer, Townend, Powell, Carr and Johannessen, and, I think, the most classical field I have been in. I drew sixth position, with Hampson fifth and Powell seventh.
